speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your symptoms in detail, specifically regarding your fatigue, flank pain, and the fever you developed after your recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis.

Since your flank pain and fever persisted despite the treatment for sinusitis, I am concerned about a secondary urinary tract infection. Have you experienced any dysuria (painful urination), urgency, or increased frequency of urination?
